name: devstack
description: Local test harness for the store: real Postgres (PGlite) behind a PostgREST/auth-compatible server, plus the project's real api/*.js handlers with a fake Razorpay. Dev tooling only -- never bundled into the site.

scripts.test:db: node test-migration.mjs && node test-rpc.mjs && node test-seed.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node e2e-checkout.mjs && node e2e-orders.mjs && node e2e-hardening.mjs && node e2e-notify.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:e2e
